messages:
edr-bot: Alert - High severity: Suspicious autorun persistence detected on host 'maria-mbp' (user: maria). Process: /usr/local/bin/updaterd spawned from unknown parent. Quarantined file: /private/tmp/.svchost
https://edr.redwood.internal/alert/2012346789

maria: Whoa, I didn't run anything unusual. I'm on the laptop now.

ashok: Acknowledged. I'll lead. Maria, can you disconnect from corp Wi-Fi and avoid rebooting?

it-ops: Isolating host via EDR... running: `edrctl isolate --host maria-mbp --reason "suspicious-autorun"` :hourglass:

edr-bot: Host isolated at 2026-03-19T15:23:10Z. Network access removed. Quarantine applied to /private/tmp/.svchost. Artifacts collected: process tree, memory image, LaunchAgent plist (if present).

jamie: Can we get the process tree + command line and parent PID? Paste the quick proc output.

edr-bot: Process tree excerpt:
```
PID 4321 /usr/local/bin/updaterd --check
PPID 1 (launchd)
Cmdline: /usr/local/bin/updaterd --check --update /private/tmp/.svchost
```
SHA256: 3f7a9b2c1d5e6f8a9b0c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c3d4e5f6a

ashok: Looks like autorun from removable or downloaded installer. Maria, did you plug in any USB recently?

maria: Yes — plugged in a thumb drive yesterday for slides at a customer meeting.

lisa: Please run `system_profiler SPUSBDataType > /tmp/maria_usb.txt` and paste the top block so we can get device serials.

maria: Pasted snippet: "Mass Storage Device: Vendor: SanDisk, Serial: 4C5300012304"

ashok: Jamie, check hash against VT/internal blacklist.

jamie: Quick check: VirusTotal shows 12 detections (heuristic flags). Internal hash lookup: no prior incidents. Uploading sample to sandbox now. Sandbox link: https://sandbox.redwood.internal/jobs/5872

it-ops: Kicking off full EDR scan: `edrctl scan --host maria-mbp --scope full --output /tmp/scan-report.json` — ETA 12m.

edr-bot: Full scan started.

edr-bot: Full scan complete. Findings: 2 additional suspicious artifacts quarantined:
- /Users/maria/Library/LaunchAgents/com.updater.plist
- /private/tmp/installer.sh
Memory image and logs uploaded to forensics bucket.

ashok: Creating incident INC-7421. Maria, do not reconnect machine to corp network until we clear. We'll provision a loaner if needed.

maria: I have deadlines today — would appreciate a loaner.

it-ops: IT ticket IT-2319 opened for loaner and temporary access.

jamie: Next steps for IR:
- Malware analysis (me)
- Collect memory dump & artifacts (lisa)
- User comms & loaner (it-ops)
- Incident lead / coord (ashok)
Also request KMS audit logs for any key activity from maria between 2026-03-18T00:00 and 2026-03-19T15:30.

lisa: Memory image uploaded: s3://forensics/maria-mbp/2012346789/memdump.img (restricted). Ran `strings` on binary; found base64 blob and obfuscated downloader. Uploaded extracted payload to sandbox.

edr-bot: Forensics artifacts: process logs, network connection attempts, and file hashes attached to INC-7421.

jamie: Sandbox analysis: binary is an obfuscated downloader. It attempts callbacks to hxxp://198.51.100.42:8080/beacon and tries to drop a LaunchAgent. No successful outbound exfil observed while host was isolated.

ashok: Good containment. Action items:
- If analysis confirms LaunchAgent persistence, reimage machine.
- Rotate any KMS keys if we detect suspicious key usage. Security team will coordinate with infra.
- Update detection rule for autorun heuristics and add the thumb drive serial to IOC list.

maria: Thanks all. Appreciate the quick response. :heart:

it-ops: Loaner delivered (IT-2319). Maria, IT will help restore from backup after reimage.

lisa: Collected timeline and artifacts uploaded to INC-7421. Also captured `/var/log/system.log` around 2026-03-19T14:50-15:25.

ashok: Drafting post-incident notes: reimage recommended, rotate creds if any admin actions detected, add user training note. Will schedule retro with eng-security.

jamie: Created postmortem doc and retro invite: https://docs.redwood.internal/incident/INC-7421/postmortem — retro scheduled 2026-03-22 10:00 PT.

edr-bot: Incident INC-7421 marked triaged.

ashok: Closing comments: tune EDR autorun signatures, add USB serial blocking for non-admins, ensure KMS audit query is in the postmortem appendix.

maria: Thanks team, back on loaner and will await IT for restore.

ashok: Thanks everyone — great work. :thumbsup:
